quizzes.title: Government Response to LWE
quizzes.passage:
Left Wing Extremism refers to armed movements that seek societal and political change through revolutionary methods. Its supporters aim to overthrow the central government through armed revolution and guerrilla warfare, and to establish a communist state based on Maoist principles. The movement is traced to an uprising in 1967. The booklet links it to several factors. Displacement of tribal populations, caused by development projects and mining operations, is one of them. Tribal dissatisfaction with the Forest (Conservation) Act 1980 is another, because that law prohibits tribes from harvesting forest resources. Poverty and a lack of sustainable means also drive people towards the movement, while lack of effective governance and insufficient technical intelligence are listed as further factors. The booklet describes a Red Corridor of states where the movement has been most severe.

The government's response has several strands. It has adopted a national policy and action plan, and it works through a doctrine called SAMADHAN, which is built from a set of elements that guide operations. Development programmes for tribal regions form another strand, and these include the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan, PM-JANMAN and the Van Dhan Vikas Kendra. Special Central Assistance is also available for public infrastructure and services in affected areas. The government set 31 March 2026 as the deadline to eliminate Left Wing Extremism, and India has since been declared Naxal-Free.

questions.q: The National Policy and Action Plan to address Left Wing Extremism is dated to which year?
questions.explanation: The booklet presents the national policy and action plan against LWE as a 2015 policy.

questions.q: In the SAMADHAN doctrine, what does the letter M stand for?
questions.explanation: The M element of SAMADHAN is Motivation and Training.

questions.q: What does the Van Dhan Vikas Kendra promote?
options: Value addition to minor forest produce
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Van Dhan Vikas Kendra clusters promote value addition to minor forest produce.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The Bandyopadhyay Committee recommended tribal-friendly land acquisition and rehabilitation.
Reason (R): The Bandyopadhyay Committee highlighted the lack of governance against tribals.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements appear in the booklet, but the booklet does not link the governance findings to the land recommendation.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Van Dhan Vikas Kendra
II. PM-JANMAN
III. Bastariya Battalion
IV. National Policy and Action Plan
A. Local recruits who know the language and terrain
B. Value addition to minor forest produce
C. Basic infrastructure and healthcare in remote habitations
D. Framework of the national response to Left Wing Extremism
questions.explanation: Van Dhan matches B, PM-JANMAN matches C, Bastariya matches A and the national policy matches D.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Bandyopadhyay Committee and SAMADHAN:
I. The Bandyopadhyay Committee recommended tribal-friendly land acquisition and rehabilitation.
II. Bastariya Battalion is based in Jharkhand.
III. In SAMADHAN, N stands for No access to Financing.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III match the booklet, while II is wrong because the Bastariya Battalion is in Chhattisgarh.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the SAMADHAN doctrine and PM-JANMAN:
I. PM-JANMAN targets 75 PVTGs.
II. The D in SAMADHAN stands for Development of tribal villages.
III. The H in SAMADHAN stands for Harnessing Technology.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while D stands for Dashboard Based KPIs and KRAs.

quizzes.title: SAMADHAN and Tribal Schemes
quizzes.passage: The booklet presents the government's response to Left Wing Extremism in several parts. One part is a security doctrine named SAMADHAN, whose letters stand for a set of elements that guide planning and operations. Operations are also supported by Company Operating Bases, which are used to penetrate remote zones. The Greyhounds operate as an elite commando force, and the Bastariya Battalion is made up of local recruits who know the language and terrain. A second part of the response is a set of development programmes for tribal regions. The Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan works in tribal villages, the Van Dhan Vikas Kendra works through clusters, and PM-JANMAN is meant for tribal groups living in remote habitations. The Bandyopadhyay Committee, an earlier review of tribal conditions, highlighted governance gaps and discrimination. Its report recommended that land acquisition and rehabilitation be made friendlier to tribals. Special Central Assistance is provided to support public infrastructure and services. Financial action has also been taken, with agencies such as the National Investigation Agency and the Enforcement Directorate seizing assets and disrupting urban funding networks. The government set 31 March 2026 as the deadline to eliminate Left Wing Extremism. The Surrender-cum-Rehabilitation Policy offers cash benefits and skill training to those who give up.

questions.q: How many elements does the SAMADHAN doctrine contain? (give the number)
questions.explanation: The letters of SAMADHAN spell out eight separate elements.

questions.q: In which state is the Bastariya Battalion located?
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the Bastariya Battalion as local recruits in Chhattisgarh.

questions.q: PM-JANMAN targets how many PVTGs? (give the number)
questions.explanation: PM-JANMAN targets 75 PVTGs for basic infrastructure and healthcare.

questions.q: In which year is the Bandyopadhyay Committee dated? (give the year)
questions.explanation: The booklet dates the Bandyopadhyay Committee to 2006.

questions.q: What does the letter S stand for in the SAMADHAN doctrine? (give the two-word element)
questions.explanation: S in SAMADHAN stands for Smart Leadership.

questions.q: What does the letter H stand for in the SAMADHAN doctrine? (give the two-word element)
questions.explanation: H in SAMADHAN stands for Harnessing Technology.

questions.q: What does the letter D stand for in the SAMADHAN doctrine? (give the element as written in the booklet)
questions.explanation: D in SAMADHAN is Dashboard Based KPIs and KRAs, meaning key performance indicators and key result areas.
